title: Resume the CFB allocation-chain walk instead of restarting it on every range read
code_state: crates/litchi-cfb/src/{shared.rs,lib.rs} and crates/litchi-xls/src/workbook/source.rs modified; no other file under crates/ touched
reason_codes: the mechanism is measured: the flagship open walks 5,796 FAT links before and 2,099 after, reproducing change 0574's independently captured 5,796 exactly
instructions and cycles both fall on every measured cell; the flagship open falls 11.44% in instructions and 8.34% in cycles
paired A/B/B/A medians improve in both directions in two windows on all six cells, every improvement larger than the widest same-binary excursion of 0.94%
reads, read bytes, source-version observations and refusal texts are identical over all 126 XLS fixtures and over 18 counted cells
the first implementation, a retained SharedOleStreamCursor, was measured and rejected: it removed more instructions but added cycles and regressed the flagship by 4.0% to 4.5% at p50

accepted_evidence.deterministic_counters: 18 cells, three source implementations by three operations by two legs, 20 warmups and 100 samples, every logical counter constant across all samples and identical between legs
accepted_evidence.corpus_differential: one source-backed open of each of 126 XLS and XLT fixtures through a range-recording positional source, comparing read count, read bytes, source-version count, an FNV-1a digest of the exact positional read ranges, and the refusal text; the two logs are byte-identical
accepted_evidence.hardware_counters: perf stat isolation pairs at 1100 and 100 samples divided by 1000, on three fixtures by two source implementations
accepted_evidence.instruction_attribution: callgrind isolation pairs on eight fixtures including all three whose Workbook stream is mini-stream resident, annotated at threshold 100 so no small edge is dropped
accepted_evidence.latency: paired A/B/B/A medians, 100 warmups and 3000 samples, two windows, with the same binary against itself as the noise floor in each window
accepted_evidence.mutation_checks: six mutations of the hint logic; two are caught by targeted tests, one by three differential tests, and three are rejected by the crate's own dead-field lint and are individually redundant given the others

accepted_costs.latency_scope: warm page cache, staged immutable copy, one host, two binaries differing in three files; host quiescence not established
accepted_costs.callgrind_string_ops: memset and memcpy instruction counts remain upper bounds because Valgrind instruments ERMS string loops per iteration; this change touches neither
accepted_costs.api_surface: one new public type (StreamChainHint) and two new public methods (SharedOleFile::chain_hint, SharedOleFile::read_stream_range_hinted)

known_gaps.formats: only XLS was measured; litchi-doc issues the same repeated-range-read pattern and is not changed or measured here
known_gaps.concentration: the saving scales with how many fills a scan issues over how long a chain; two fixtures move by less than 0.15% of instructions and are within isolation-pair noise
known_gaps.mini_stream: the three mini-stream-resident fixtures gain 8, 8 and 0 chain steps per open, which is nearly nothing; no wall clock was taken for them
known_gaps.worksheet_scan: the worksheet scan already uses a cursor and is untouched; no attempt was made to move it onto the hint

withheld: any cold-cache, physical-device, remote or range-source, peak-RSS, allocation-profile, concurrency-scaling, real-producer or cross-platform result
any DOC, PPT, XLSX or non-OLE2 result

provenance.note: both legs were built from a detached git worktree of the base revision outside the repository working copy, each with its own CARGO_TARGET_DIR; the after leg differs only in the three files this change edits

gates.suites: 6,355 tests, 0 failures, 233 binaries across litchi-xls, litchi-cfb, litchi-biff, litchi-ole-common, litchi-doc, litchi-ppt, litchi-xlsx, litchi-xlsb
gates.known_red_unchanged: litchi facade library tests 380 pass / 3 fail (document::doc, pre-existing at HEAD); tools/check_example_targets.py duplicate example targets in iWork crates (pre-existing at HEAD)
